Chat request that results in parallel tool calls in the response

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather in NYC and London?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"parallel_tool_calls\":true,\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city name\",\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().toolCalls() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
```
